label: healthy
description: RET-3 boundary: the agent hits a couple of transient rate-limited searches, then does genuine work (an edit, a passing test run, a commit), then resumes with a short fresh search burst. RET-2 must not merge the two search phases across the real work into one dominating run -- because only the trailing uninterrupted run of a tool counts (the counter resets on a genuinely different action), the final 3-call search burst is too short to dominate, so nothing fires. A naive bag-of-occurrences count over the window would risk a false alarm here.
